ITEM 1 | Flat fish-like fillet piece, light gray-brown outer skin with darker speckled crust, pale cream flesh showing at the edge, roughly 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, lying diagonally on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Crumbly topping of golden-tan bits with pale yellow kernels and small brown granules, slightly glossy, some dark flecks and thin green herb strands scattered over the fillet and around its base, covering roughly 6 by 6 cm area | 60
ITEM 3 | Cluster of shredded leafy greens with pale green stems and darker green-edged leaves, moist-looking, slightly wilted, folded into a mound about 8 by 6 cm and about 2.5 cm high, with a few small red chili pieces mixed in, on the right of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Long thin green beans, bright green with slightly tough texture, one lying loose at top left (about 8 cm) and two or three near the bottom right and among the greens (about 6 to 10 cm each), dry surfaces | 15
ITEM 5 | Small scattered pieces of red chili and tiny flecks of brown seasoning dispersed among the crumble and greens, dry-looking | 3
